title: 第十二章 华雄夜袭（中）

content_zh:
而且并州不缺少战马，谁知道吕布暗地里还有没有留一手，虽说朝廷任命上党太守张扬为并州牧，谁都知道张扬是个什么货色，一旦吕布回军，肯定是乖乖的让权。
“吕布个匹夫，多次辱我，此仇不报，枉为人子。”袁术最近的脾气越来越坏了，本来总督粮草是个很肥的差事，可是吕布接连捣乱，让他如鲠在喉。
“将军，吕布这厮勇武，不妨明日言明，让他充当先锋攻打汜水关。”
“上次就是你说孙坚可能会攻破汜水关，本将军听了你的话克扣粮草，结果闹得不可开交，现在孙坚见到我还像是见到仇人一样，若不是念在你往日有功的份上，早将你拖出去斩了。”袁术冷哼道。
“将军，我这也是为您好啊，您看，孙坚号称江东猛虎，有万夫不当之勇，且与将军治下相近，若是任由其坐大，后果不堪设想，如今他的人马折了一半，实力大损，等回去之后还不是乖乖听从将军的。”
“嗯，有理，有理。”袁术的脸上露出笑容，似乎看到孙坚投靠自己的画面。
“吕布手下人马虽然仅有万余，却有两千骑兵，据说其手下有一支队伍号称陷阵营，之前与董贼交战时，硬生生的挡住了西凉骑兵的冲锋，不容小觑，此人不除，恐怕以后会是将军的心腹大患。”
“好，事成之后，少不了你的好处。”袁术脸上露出了笑意。
“多谢将军。”
一连数日，华雄紧闭关门，高挂免战牌。
李傕郭汜的到来，让华雄定了心，关内的兵马达到了七万人，诸侯想要攻破汜水关，如同做梦。
“华将军，我军虽然败了一阵，士气仍旧高昂，诸侯胜了一场，必定心生怠慢，如今大军到来，何不趁机出城杀上一阵，也好挫一下联军的锐气。”李肃趁机道。
华雄眉头微皱，之前就是听了李肃的建议，带兵去找诸侯的晦气，虽然斩杀了两名大将，却差点将自己搭在了里面。
“华将军，机不可失啊，若是一举将诸侯击溃，乃是不世之功，封候拜将指日可待。”李肃急道。
华雄沉思良久，点了点头“今晚三更之时，本将军带领三千骑兵，偷袭诸侯大营，李傕领一万兵马随后掩杀，郭汜领一万兵马策应，关内就交给李先生了。”
“恭祝将军旗开得胜。”李肃躬身道，只要华雄偷袭能够成功，以他的功劳，肯定能得到封赏。
寂静的夜里，一轮弯月当空，汜水关的关门悄悄“前方就是诸侯大营，杀死一名诸侯士兵，赏千钱，杀死诸侯将领，赏十万钱，连升两级，杀死诸侯者，赏百金，连升三级，杀死袁绍者，赏千金，连升五级。”
华雄在三千骑兵的耳中是那么的动人心弦，百金、千金，提拔官职，他们辛辛苦苦当兵，为的不就是这些吗，许多人眼中露出嗜血的光芒。
之前的一场小胜，挫了华雄的锐气，诸侯们宽心不少。
“伍长，你说我们什么时候能回家？”

“回家？”伍长王二嗤笑一声“刘三，不要做梦了，不攻破雒阳，别想着回去。”
“汜水关那么高？怎么打上去？”刘三惊呼道。
“不是有云梯吗，爬上去。”王二优哉游哉的闭上眼睛，丝毫不知死神已经悄然降临。
三千骑兵冲锋起来的声势惊天动地，负责巡逻的士兵茫然不知何故，而一些经历过战争的老兵则是面色发白，他们明白，这样的声势，只有骑兵冲锋才具备。
三千骑兵在华雄的带领下，轻易杀入诸侯大营，手中的火把，不停的甩向一个个营帐，一时间火光四起。
正在梦乡的诸侯士兵，被突来的袭击惊醒，营中燃起的火焰，唤起了他们心中的恐惧，很多士兵顾不得穿衣服就向外跑去。
李傕见诸侯大营火光四起，带领一万士兵杀来，一路势如破竹。
诸侯中靠近寨门的位置乃是山阳太守袁遗，他手下的万名士兵在骑兵的冲锋下，开始了大逃亡，向其他诸侯的营帐窜去。
袁遗在亲卫的保护下，杀出一条血路，赶往袁术所在的大帐。
二十余万诸侯联军，营帐浩浩荡荡，从上面观察可以看到，整个诸侯大营点点火光越来越多。

content_en:
Moreover, there is no shortage of war horses in Bingzhou. Who knows if Lu Bu has a hand in secret? Although the imperial court appointed Zhang Yang, the governor of Shangdang, as the shepherd of Bingzhou, everyone knows what Zhang Yang is. Once Lu Bu returns to the army, he will definitely give up power obediently.
"Lü Bu is a common man. He has insulted me many times. If I don't take revenge for this, I will be a son of man in vain." Yuan Shu's temper has become worse and worse recently. Originally, the governor of grain and grass was a very fat job, but Lu Bu made trouble one after another, which made him feel like a stick in his throat.
"General, Lu Bu is a brave man. You might as well make it clear tomorrow and let him be the vanguard to attack Sishui Pass."
"You were the one who said last time that Sun Jian might break through the Sishui Pass. I listened to your words and withheld food and fodder, which resulted in a huge commotion. Now when Sun Jian sees me, it's like seeing an enemy. If he hadn't been thinking about your past merits, he would have dragged you out and executed you long ago." Yuan Shu snorted coldly.
"General, I am doing this for your own good. You see, Sun Jian is known as the Tiger of the East of the Yangtze. He has bravery that cannot be matched by ten thousand people, and he is similar to the general's rule. If he is allowed to become powerful, the consequences will be disastrous. Now his troops have been reduced by half, and his strength has been greatly reduced. When he returns, he will not obey the general obediently."
"Well, it makes sense, it makes sense." Yuan Shu had a smile on his face, as if he saw Sun Jian surrendering to him.
"Although Lu Bu has only over ten thousand men, he has two thousand cavalry. It is said that a team under him is said to be trapped in the camp. When fighting the Dong thieves before, they blocked the charge of the Xiliang cavalry. They should not be underestimated. If this person is not eliminated, I am afraid he will be a serious problem for the general in the future."
"Okay, once everything is done, you will benefit from it." Yuan Shu showed a smile on his face.
"Thank you, General."
For several days, Hua Xiong closed the door tightly and hung up his no-war card.
The arrival of Li Jue and Guo Si reassured Hua Xiong. The number of soldiers and horses in the pass reached 70,000. It was like a dream for the princes to break through Sishui Pass.
"General Hua, although our army has been defeated for a while, the morale of our army is still high. After the princes won a victory, they will definitely feel lazy. Now that the army is coming, why not take the opportunity to go out of the city and fight for a while, so as to dampen the spirit of the coalition forces." Li Su took the opportunity to say.
Hua Xiong frowned slightly. He had listened to Li Su's suggestion and led troops to find bad luck for the princes. Although he killed two generals, he almost got himself involved.
"General Hua, you can't miss this opportunity. If you defeat the princes in one fell swoop, it will be an unparalleled achievement. You will be granted the title of general just around the corner." Li Su said anxiously.
Hua Xiong thought for a long time and nodded, "At the third watch tonight, I, the general, will lead three thousand cavalry to sneak attack the princes' camp. Li Jue will lead ten thousand soldiers and horses to cover up and kill them. Guo Si will lead ten thousand soldiers and horses to respond. The pass will be handed over to Mr. Li."
"Congratulations to the general for victory." Li Su bowed and said, as long as Hua Xiong's sneak attack can succeed, he will definitely be rewarded for his contribution.
In the silent night, with a crescent moon in the sky, the door of Sishui Pass quietly closed. "Ahead is the camp of the princes. If you kill a soldier of the princes, you will be rewarded with a thousand gold coins. If you kill the general of the princes, you will be rewarded with a hundred thousand gold coins. You will be promoted to two levels in a row. If you kill a prince, you will be rewarded with a hundred gold coins. You will be promoted to three levels in a row. If you kill Yuan Shao, you will be rewarded with a thousand gold coins. He will be promoted to five levels in a row."
Hua Xiong was so touching in the ears of the three thousand cavalrymen. Hundreds of gold, thousands of gold, and promotion to official positions. Isn't that what they worked hard for as soldiers? Many people's eyes showed a bloodthirsty light.
The previous small victory dampened Hua Xiong's energy, and the princes felt relieved.
"Captain, when do you think we can go home?"
"Go home?" Wu Commander Wang Er sneered, "Liu San, stop dreaming. Don't even think about going back until Luoyang is conquered."
"Sishui Pass is so high? How to get up there?" Liu San exclaimed.
"Isn't there a ladder? Climb up." Wang Er closed his eyes leisurely, unaware that death had quietly arrived.
The momentum of the three thousand cavalry charges was earth-shattering. The soldiers in charge of the patrol were at a loss and didn't know why. Some veterans who had experienced the war turned pale. They understood, such a momentum can only be possessed by a cavalry charge.
Three thousand cavalrymen, led by Hua Xiong, easily entered the princes' camp. The torches in their hands kept throwing towards each tent, and flames suddenly burst out.
The soldiers of the princes who were sleeping were awakened by the sudden attack. The flames ignited in the camp aroused the fear in their hearts. Many soldiers ran out without even bothering to put on their clothes.
When Li Jue saw the princes' camp bursting with flames, he led 10,000 soldiers to attack them.
Among the princes, Yuan Yi, the prefect of Shanyang, was located near the gate of the village. Under the charge of the cavalry, his ten thousand soldiers began a great escape and rushed towards the camps of other princes.
Under the protection of his personal guards, Yuan Yi fought his way through and rushed to Yuan Shu's tent.
There are more than 200,000 princes allied forces, and the camp is vast. From above, you can see that the entire prince camp is lit with more and more lights.
